paper_id: MuxFlow_ Efficient and Safe GPU Sharing in Large-Scale Production Deep Learning Clusters
title: MuxFlow: Efficient and Safe GPU Sharing in Large-Scale Production Deep Learning Clusters
motivation: 生产GPU集群利用率低(26%)，在线负载无法充分利用GPU，离线负载需要填充空闲资源
problem_framing: 在保障在线负载性能和安全的前提下，通过空间共享提升GPU利用率
key_insight: MPS可空间共享但无法保证性能和安全性；两层保护机制+混合错误处理可解决此问题
method_signature: xCUDA两层性能保护+混合错误处理+动态SM分配+匹配调度
evaluation_criteria: GPU利用率26%→76%，延迟增加<20%，错误率<0.9%
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: MuxFlow错误率0.9%略高于Online-only的0.7%；多负载共享存在挑战
evidence_for_taste: 99% propagated errors are caused by SIGINT and SIGTERM
almost all unsafe cases in our deployment can be handled
the increase of the error rate is much less than the increase of the executed containers
MuxFlow only accepts trustworthy offline workloads
sharing multiple offline workloads with multiple online workloads may bring more benefits, especially for lightweighted offline workloads
thinking_moves: 从生产环境错误数据反推错误根因分布(99% vs 1%)
将保护问题分解为两层：负载级+xCUDA和GPU级+SysMonitor
将调度问题形式化为最大权二分图匹配问题并用KM算法求解
将不可能的任务拆分为可工程化的子问题
承认系统局限性：仅接受可信离线负载，外部云用户需要更多保护
